student_trainee_exemption.quote: Allow for the training of anesthesiologist assistant students if a student is: (i) enrolled in an anesthesiologist assistant program that is accredited by the Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs or by its predecessor or successor organization; and (ii) supervised by an individual who meets the requirements of clause (A).
